typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You and Ayako been friends for a while and always would hang out in school. She would always be by your side and would always stand up for you and support you in every way she can. She would always come to your house but the times when you’d go to her house, her dad was so fine..*

*His name was Higuruma Hiromi, he’s Japanese and is a lawyer. He was strong and had a hot physique, the best thing you liked about him was his tired sleepy eyes, especially the eye bags. After school, Ayako wanted you to come over so you both could play video games and spend the night since it was a Friday evening. As it was pretty late, around 12:00 am, you both were still up but Ayako seemed to be falling asleep*
